title: Overcoming key challenges in the evolutionary transition to multicellularity
title_zh: 跨越多细胞性进化过渡的关键挑战
abstract: Dozens of independent origins of multicellularity have profoundly shaped Earth’s evolutionary and ecological history. These transitions have given rise to massive radiations encompassing thousands to millions of species and the evolution of increasingly complex bodies. Multicellular taxa now constitute the majority of Earth’s biomass and have fundamentally transformed global ecosystems, underpinning diverse biomes from forests and grasslands to coral reefs. While these macroevolutionary patterns have long been recognized, the microevolutionary processes driving the transition to multicellularity have remained unclear. Questions remain on how solitary cells form cohesive groups, how these groups become evolutionary units capable of adaptation at the multicellular level, and how novel cell types and developmental patterns emerge. Recent discoveries of previously unknown multicellular species and the development of experimental models have provided important insights into these questions. This work reveals that seemingly insurmountable evolutionary hurdles are often readily overcome either through the repurposing of ancestral unicellular traits or through emergent properties of multicellular collectives that arise spontaneously. Here we review key breakthroughs in our understanding of the microevolutionary processes that underpin the evolution of increasingly complex multicellularity, focusing on mechanisms through which single cells can evolve into functionally integrated multicellular organisms. This Review synthesizes an evolutionary framework for understanding the key stages, challenges and microevolutionary processes through which single cells evolve into functionally integrated multicellular organisms.
abstract_zh: 数十次独立的多细胞起源深刻塑造了地球的进化和生态历史。这些转变催生了包含数千到数百万物种的大规放射，并促进了日益复杂身体的进化。多细胞类群现在构成了地球生物量的大多数，并从森林、草原到珊瑚礁的多样化生态系统中根本性转变。虽然已经长期认识到这些宏观进化模式，但驱动向多细胞性过渡的微进化过程仍然不清楚。人们仍然存在关于孤单细胞如何形成凝聚群体、这些群体如何成为能够在多细胞水平上适应的进化单位，以及如何产生新细胞类型和发育模式的问题。最近对先前未知多细胞物种的发现以及实验模型的开发，为这些问题提供了重要的见解。本文揭示了看似不可逾越的进化障碍往往通过祖先单细胞性状的重新利用或多细胞集合涌现的自发性质来轻易跨越。我们综述了我们对支撑日益复杂多细胞性微进化过程的理解的关键突破，重点关注单细胞如何进化为功能整合的多细胞生物。本综述综合了一个理解单细胞进化为功能整合的多细胞生物的进化框架，阐明了关键阶段、挑战和微进化过程。
